purpose: Final print-file review of the Mark1 equipment lid before the full build. Widths and path clearances are from CAD and commanded extrusion, in millimetres.

ten_m5_stations.shank_measurement: Twice the minimum distance from the bore axis to a commanded centreline, less the bead width, from the build plate through the lid face.

reservoir_air_tubes_4mm.probe: Both axes probed through the complete 7.4 mm deck.

exits: toward the V-B valve side then up
out through underside of the Reservoir B fill groove
accessible_support.probe: Sampled command midpoints on five automatic trees; force and connected-tree release are physical observations.
